denominator: eligible_throws includes all qualified official throws in the left join, matched or not. matched_chart_rows is separate. Per-flag rates use positive/known; support uses known/eligible_throws. Missing annotation is not false.
clock: charted_feature_support.latest_feature_available is the latest globally eligible chart/PBP reconstruction upper bound. F1 actual charting inputs are only own support/age; F2 additionally uses earlier global rate priors. Do not call F1 global field the freshest consumed own chart observation.
game_scope: Team/opponent aggregates use qualified QB passer rows, including backups, not every non-QB trick-play passer or all team dropbacks. No claim of a complete team opportunity model or pure defensive talent.
closed_failure: Relative output path caused postwrite invocation errors; complete retained fit was reused, no successful fit repeated. Conservative resource charge retained.
